law: Babies are snapshot-born successor engines (BTC 5-min, SIM/SHADOW only — no real money; the unanimous-vote law seq 22761 is untouched). Graded per $1 at fire-time mid, house fee law. A voter seat is earned by the record, never granted.

not_born.why_not_born: cannot be backtested from snapshot records — engine/caller calls are stored untimed, so any backtest would grade it on information it could not have had at fire time

babies.label: SNAPSHOT BABY — ONE-TURNER
babies.in_words: When one move of >= 0.30 mid points lands out of a quiet window (pre-move range <= 0.30) with no cross-back yet, call the direction of the move — at the step, not after it.
parentage: ONE_TURNER family (snapshot_lib.classify): quiet window, one move >= 0.30, no cross-back
Discovery finding 2026-11-19: 16 one-turners, median pre-move range 0.12, median step 0.45 at median 227s, no cross-back; PLAIN and EARLY both hit 1.0 on the family in the backfill census
Buoy route ONE_TURNER: quiet -> still quiet -> THE STEP -> no cross-back; the fire point is the step itself
babies.status: CHALLENGER — live shadow trial running; NOT a seated voter (backtest bar not met)

babies.label: SNAPSHOT BABY — CLEAN
babies.in_words: From 120s in: if one side has held the window (<= 1 crossing, >= 75% of polls on its side) and leads by >= 0.15, call the leader and ride it.
parentage: CLEAN family (snapshot_lib.classify): <= 1 crossing, one side dominant >= 80% of the window, and it won
Backfill census 2026-11-19: CLEAN n=35, PLAIN hit 1.0, crowd hit 0.97 — the clean leader almost never loses
Buoy route CLEAN: side set @120s (|mid-0.5| >= 0.15, <= 1 cross) -> no cross @240s -> holds @280s
babies.status: CHALLENGER — live shadow trial running; NOT a seated voter (backtest bar not met)

babies.label: SNAPSHOT BABY — FLIP
babies.in_words: A side led >= 0.60 before 240s; after 240s the price crosses AGAINST that leader and stays across — call the breaking side (fade the broken leader) at the crack.
parentage: FLIP family (snapshot_lib.classify): a side led >= 0.60 before 240s and LOST
Discovery finding 2026-11-19: 8 flips, median leader mid 0.818 before 240s, median final break 251.5s; EARLY hit 0.0 on the family — following the strong early leader was the losing play
Everyone-loses lessons (snapshot overlay): when the obvious side breaks late, the break is the signal
Buoy route FLIP: leader @150s -> leader holds @240s -> first crack -> THE BREAK
babies.status: CHALLENGER — live shadow trial running; NOT a seated voter (backtest bar not met)

babies.label: SNAPSHOT BABY — CHOP
babies.in_words: Once the window has crossed 50c >= 4 times and 150s have passed, call the side the price currently sits on (the side of the last cross).
parentage: CHOP family (snapshot_lib.classify): >= 4 crossings of 50c — the book never agreed on a direction
Backfill census 2026-11-19: CHOP n=7, crowd hit 1.0 (small family, printed honestly); PLAIN made no counted calls in chop at all
WHY label two_way_chop: in a storm the last cross is the only fresh information there is
babies.status: CHALLENGER — live shadow trial running; NOT a seated voter (backtest bar not met)
